name: Scapular Push-Up
steps: Start in a high plank with your palms beneath your shoulders, elbows straight, and body aligned from head to heels.
Keep your elbows straight and allow your shoulder blades to slide together as your chest lowers slightly.
Push forcefully through your palms to spread your shoulder blades apart around your rib cage and slightly round your upper back.
Let your shoulder blades glide together again without bending your elbows.
tips: Keep your elbows completely locked throughout so all movement comes strictly from your shoulder blades.
Do not allow your lower back to sag or your hips to bounce up and down.
